description: Rights-safe artifact inventory for Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy. Built from 306 raw artifact candidates and deduplicated to 269 metadata candidates. No copyrighted full text is included in Git; redistributable is false by default until rights, hashes, and licenses are manually verified.
